verdict.rationale: The docs say collections exist for 'collaboration with your team' (docs-37). The changelog adds team search in workspace search (docs-39), and the MCP server exposes 'teams' alongside collections (docs-32). The GitHub README frames Hoppscotch as helping you 'collaborate across your teams' (gh-6). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of synced or real-time shared workspaces, details on team roles and permissions for shared collections, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team sharing.
